title: Report what was checked
summary: A test summary says what ran, what passed and what remains unchecked. It should not promise more than the evidence supports.
introduction: A test summary says what ran, what passed and what remains unchecked. It should not promise more than the evidence supports. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A test summary says what ran, what passed and what remains unchecked. It should not promise more than the evidence supports.

blocks.code:

Passed: 14 cases
Failed: 1 keyboard case
Not checked: old browser versions
blocks.title: Report what was checked

blocks.text: The summary tells others both the useful evidence and its limits.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Write a two-line summary for three tests you tried.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not say all browsers work when only one browser was checked.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
